name: Kevin Ha
tagline: Building systems where multiple agents think together.
role: Computer Science M.Sc. student · Multi-Agent Systems & ML
bio: I'm a Computer Science student at RWTH Aachen University, currently pursuing my M.Sc. after completing my B.Sc. in 2025.

My main interest is designing multi-agent and LLM-based systems: autonomous agents that plan, retrieve, and reason together to solve problems no single model handles well alone. I care about the engineering around the models as much as the models themselves — clean data flow, observable pipelines, and interfaces that make complex systems feel simple.
When I approach a problem, I start by splitting it into roles rather than features: who plans, who gathers evidence, who decides. The demo on this page is built exactly that way.
